span.p:
S_pers > 0 ?
beats the last observed value

div.style: color: rgb(26, 26, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Do not deploy.
Persistence is cheaper and better.
Typical of high-inertia variables whose
autocorrelation time exceeds the horizon.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(26, 26, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Seasonal artefact.
The model has learned what month it is.
Ship the climatology instead — it is cheaper
to compute, cheaper to serve, and better.
Invisible if only S_pers is reported.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Does S_clim hold up
as the horizon grows ?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Partly seasonal.
Genuine skill at short range, decaying to a
seasonal lookup at long range. Report the
horizon at which it crosses.

div.style: color: rgb(26, 26, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Genuine forecast skill.
Information beyond both the present state
and the seasonal cycle.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Does it transfer to
a held-out site ?

div.style: color: rgb(26, 26, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Interpolation, not transfer.
Pooled metrics overstate what a user
clicking unseen ocean will get.
Restrict to trained sites, or say so.

div.style: color: rgb(26, 26, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Deployable at arbitrary coordinates.
Report the held-out figure, not the
pooled one, as the expected skill.
